name: Partial Fleet Loss Mission Continuity
summary: Two UAVs are lost at once; the surviving team must keep the mission-critical core and report the rest.
objective: Keep the mission-critical core of {critical_task} running after {lost_uavs} are lost at t = {loss_at_s} s, delivering at least {keep_pct} % of the original plan with the surviving UAVs.
brief: At about t = {loss_at_s} s, {lost_uavs} are lost (link and telemetry gone). The mission still needs at least {keep_pct} % of the {critical_task} work done. Re-plan the surviving fleet, protect the critical core of the plan, and declare what is dropped and why. Do not launch a search for the lost UAVs.

parameters.name: keep_pct
parameters.desc: Fraction of the plan that must still be delivered

actions: report dropped work and residual risk

checkpoints.name: Loss declaration
checkpoints.metric: time from loss to acknowledged statement

checkpoints.name: Continuity
checkpoints.metric: fraction of the original plan delivered

checkpoints.name: No futile search
checkpoints.metric: time spent searching for the lost UAVs

checkpoints.name: Report
checkpoints.target: report lists dropped tasks with reasons

constraints: surviving UAVs may not leave the geofence
no new tasks after t = 900 s
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
